messages.content: Predict this human participant's contribution in a one-period public goods game. Participants are randomly assigned to groups of four. Each person receives 20 points, where 1 point equals EUR 0.20. All four choose simultaneously how many points to put into a shared project and how many to keep privately. If you contribute c points, you keep 20-c points privately. Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.

Each point contributed to the project gives 0.4 points to each of the four members. Your game earnings in points are 20-c + 0.4*(the sum of all four contributions, including yours). There is no earlier round in this one-period game and no current partner contribution is known when choosing. Only participants correctly answering both incentive-comprehension questions can submit the payout-relevant decision. In addition to the game earnings, participation pays EUR 4. After all participants in the collection wave finish, experimenters calculate earnings and pay EUR 4 + 0.20*(your game earnings in points) via PayPal. The age in state, when present, is the participant's own stable self-reported age in years, collected at the end; no age is imputed. Output only the integer number of points contributed to the project, from 0 to 20 inclusive, without explanation.
